channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mqtt
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: mqtt2matter — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Create bridged Matter devices and control via MQTT. Supports manual configuration, zigbee2mqtt, Home Assistant Autodiscovery, ESPHome, ...

item.title: nanoleaf2mqtt — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Interface between Nanoleaf light panels and MQTT.

item.title: TopicBench — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Free open-source multi-broker MQTT explorer and monitor desktop client, written in Rust.

item.title: TestMQTT — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Free browser-based MQTT client for testing any broker over WebSockets: connect, subscribe, publish and debug topics with no install or sign-up.

item.title: Straum — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Experimental clustered MQTT 3.1.1 and 5 broker that acknowledges a publish only after a majority of its nodes has committed it.

item.title: ConnectMQ — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Managed MQTT broker with MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0, TLS, WebSockets and per-topic access control, no servers to run.

item.title: VelaMQ — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Rust-based MQTT broker with clustering, a web console, authentication, topic ACLs, and a SQL rule engine.

item.title: MQTT Scope — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Desktop MQTT client for Linux, Windows and macOS with a live topic tree, a large-message inspector with diff, and live plots of any JSON field. Website.

item.title: MockForge — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Open-source multi-protocol mock server written in Rust with a built-in MQTT 3.1.1/5.0 broker for testing, alongside HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka and AMQP mocks.

item.title: mqttv5 — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: MQTT v5 client with allocation-free PUBLISH decoding, session resume, file-backed QoS 1/2 persistence and multi-broker failover.

item.title: SolidPing — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Uptime monitoring with an MQTT broker check that connects (optional TLS and auth), publishes a message on a topic and waits for it to come back, recording connect and round-trip times. Also HTTP, TCP, DNS and many other check types, self-hosted or hosted.

item.title: Spitfire — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Self-hosted distributed load testing platform with a web UI; simulates thousands of MQTT devices (QoS 0/1/2 publish, subscribe, request-reply) alongside HTTP, Kafka and other protocols. Commercial, with a free edition.

item.title: Spitfire — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Self-hosted distributed load testing platform with a web UI; simulates thousands of MQTT devices (QoS 0/1/2 publish, subscribe, request-reply) alongside HTTP, Kafka and other protocols. Commercial, with a free edition.

item.title: AimDB — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Typed, versioned data contracts over MQTT from no_std microcontrollers (Embassy) to the cloud (Tokio), with schema migrations at the hub.

item.title: Mqttable — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: A desktop MQTT workbench for traffic inspection, replay, load testing, fault injection, and PCAP analysis.

item.title: Cortex — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Generates interactive documentation, typed SDKs, and MCP servers from AsyncAPI definitions, including MQTT APIs.

item.title: mqttwarn — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Route and transform MQTT notifications, with 70+ built-in adapters for databases, messaging and other notification sinks.

item.title: MQTT Commander for iOS — via awesome-mqtt
item.description: Native iPhone and iPad client with a live topic tree, topic board, JSON inspection, and a 13-stage Connection Doctor. Supports MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 over TCP, TLS, mTLS and WebSocket.
